prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach object. If visible, move to and take it. Then inspect and move to drop bay, else scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = MoveToDropBay    /> <Action ID = MoveToObjAndTake    /> <Action ID = InspectObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = MoveToObjAndTake    /> <SubTree ID = InspectObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO MoveToObjAndTake
	ELSE
		DO InspectObject
		DO MoveToDropBay
	END
